question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**detract from**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence highlights the potential **negative effect** of using excessive figurative language in writing.
 
• The phrase "**detract from**" means **to reduce the quality, value, or effectiveness of something**, which aligns perfectly with the idea of harming the clarity of writing.
 
• Other options are inappropriate: 
 
 
• **Clarify** – means to make something clearer; opposite to the intended meaning.
 
• **Simplify** – also suggests improving clarity, which contradicts the negative tone.
 
• **Enhance** – means to improve; again, it does not match the cautionary tone of the sentence.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *...as excessive figurative language can detract from__ the clarity of the writing.* 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• "Detract from" is commonly used in both academic and literary contexts to indicate that something takes away from the effectiveness or clarity of something else.
 
• It is often used in cautionary or critical discussions about overuse, exaggeration, or distraction in communication.
